name: Better Local Graph
description: Live project context for you and your AI agents. Sew parent-child relationships between notes via the `sewing` property, bookmark nodes for quick access, cross-reference tags from the tag panel, and use the Coser A command to relate any note to your bookmarks. The embedded MCP server exposes your graph to AI agents so they know your project structure without scanning the whole vault. Lucide icons, link arrows, age-based coloring, AI tooltips (BYOK), bilingual EN/ES.
author: Pablo Zambrano
